featured_reviews.name: Jiten Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
First of all a BIG thank you to Sachin ji and Pramila ben. Amazing people and amazing work they do. KUDOS to them.
What can i say... "Ghar ka Khana, Maa ke haat ka khana, Hygiene khana," All this at a good price and on time delivery everyday.
I started this service 2 weeks back i.e. from 4th April22. Original plan was to have it for a few days as there was a medical emergency at my place, but i continue till date. Further more i am sure, I will continue.
While there are a few negative reviews on Google, my initial hesitancy was there. But when i understood the pressure of delivery that the team has, it is for us to listen to them and understand their problem. Their plate is all full and they try to accommodate any new request as they already are serving their key old customers [especially old age people].
While Sachin ji feels rude to us on the call, but if you try to understand his delivery schedule, i am sure you will give up. [I too did, Empathy is required to understand him]
I too had to initially adjust, but now everything has smoothened up and now my spose, child and me are all GAGA for the food that we get. I would rate delivery/service/food quality all 10 out of 5.Thank you Sachin & Pramila ben.

featured_reviews.review_text: I was looking to order home cooked food for my family and myself since we had grown sick of eating food ordered from hotels. The food they prepare is hygienic, subtly flavoured and doesn't overload your taste buds as hotel food does. They have a wide variety of vegetable recipes and so you can almost expect the menu to be unique every day of the week. The serving size of vegetables is generous and the food is fresh and hot when delivered. Also, the food arrives neatly packed and is satiating. The team at this establishment is very professional and on the few occasions that I did request earlier than usual delivery of food, they ensured my request was accommodated. If you are looking to order food that is consistently tasty, nutritious, hygienic and delivered on time, look no further than Naivedya Tiffin and Catering.
